Meeting Schedule

The regular meetings of the City Council are held on the second and fourth Tuesday of each month,

  1
 closed session business will usually commence at 5:30 p.m., when scheduled, and general business
session will commence at 6:30 p.m.

Brown Act

Agendas are drafted to accurately state what the legislative body is being asked to consider. The
legislative body can take action on "all items" listed on the agenda and be in compliance with the open
meeting laws. Under the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the
agenda, or unless certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The governing body may direct
staff to investigate and/or schedule certain matters for consideration at a future meeting.

City's Vision Statement

We envision a thriving, safe and inclusive community where everyone has the opportunity to access
exceptional services, education and support to be resilient and live full, vibrant lives.

Public Communications

Public Comments on agenda items are limited to three (3) minutes. All comments are to be addressed
directly to the Agency Members not to the members of the public.

Emails for public comment received prior to 4:00 pm on the day of the Council Meeting will be
summarized by the City Clerk, not read in its entirety. A copy of the email will be provided to the City
Council and will also be available at the City Clerk's Office for public review. A copy of each email will be
recorded for public record and noted on the official minutes of tonight's meeting.

GENERAL NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC

The City Council adopted new rules relating to the conduct of the public meetings, proceedings, and
business in the City of South Gate on July 12, 2022, (Resolution 2022-38-CC) and go into effect on
August 1, 2022. Resolution #2022-38-CC is available at the City Clerk’s Office.

MEETING SCHEDULE

Regular meetings of the City Council are held on the second and fourth Tuesday of each month, closed
session meetings will commence at 5:30 p.m. unless posted otherwise on its agenda. The regular City
Council meetings will commence at 6:30 p.m. Agendas are available at the following locations: City Clerk
Office, Public Notice Boards at City Hall, and on the City’s web page at https://www.cityofsouthgate.org

The Public can sign up to receive automatic notices of postings of agendas for the City Council or any
other Commission or Board of the City of South Gate. Visit the City webpage and click on the Agenda &
Minutes icon. That will take you the page where an individual can enter their email in the “Email
Updates” box to register.

PUBLIC COMMENT/PARTICIPATION

Any person may request to address a legislative body during a public meeting. The Presiding Officer will
call upon those present in the Council Chambers.

Speakers are limited to three (3) minutes on any item listed on the agenda, including public hearings.
Under Comments from the Audience portion, speakers are also limited to a single three (3) minutes time
limit. Comments from the Audience is initially limited to 45 minutes at each meeting. Any speaker still
wishing to speak, that did not speak, will have an addition Comments from the Audience opportunity after
the last business item is finished. The Presiding Officer may extend the time limit as long as there is no
objection from the City Council as a body.

To ensure that the public is able to participate, the City provides the opportunity to submit their
comments in person, email, mail. Methods of participation may be subject to change during other such
times when a State of Emergency, Health Order or State Executive Order limits in-person participation.

CURFEW

In absence of a motion duly adopted by majority vote of the City Council, the Presiding Officer may
adjourn the City Council meetings at 10:30 p.m. The Presiding Officer may ask the City Council if any
agenda items listed should be continued or dealt with during the meeting. For those items to be
continued, the City Council can direct the item be placed on the next City Council agenda or the current
meeting may be adjourned to a time certain at which time the meeting shall be reconvened as an
Adjourned Regular Meeting of the City Council and action upon the published agenda continued.

STAFF REPORTS

  3
 As a general rule, staff reports. or other written documentation are prepared/organized with respect to
each item of business listed on the agenda. Meeting agendas and staff reports are available at least 72-
hours prior to the scheduled regular City Council meeting and a minimum of 24-hours prior to a Special
City Council meeting. There are times when the City Council receives written material. revised material
after the posting of agendas, these materials are become a public record and will be available for public
view within 72-hours after the meeting in which they were received. Those materials and any other public
document can be inspected in the City Clerk's Office located at 8650 California Avenue, South Gate.

SERVICES TO FACILITATE ACCESS TO PUBLIC MEETINGS

In compliance with the American with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in the
City Council Meetings, please contact the Office of the City Clerk. Notification 48 hours prior to the City
Council Meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility. For
further information, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (323) 563-9510 or via email at
yglaze@sogate.org.

SUBJECT:  AGREEMENT  WITH  TORO  ENTERPRISES,  INC.,  TO  LEASE  THF,
CITY-OWNED  PROPERTY  LOCATED  AT  13050  PARAMOUNT  BLVD  IN  THE  CITY
(ASSESSOR  ID NO.  6264-004-900)

PURPOSE:  To lease City-owned  property  to Toro  Enterprises,  Inc., to provide  a suitable  staging
site  for  temporary  construction  equipment/materials  for  the  contractor  assigned  to the  Alley
Pavement  Rehabilitation  CIP Improvement  Project  (CIP No. 24-03)  for the City  of Downey.

RECOMMENDED  ffl

  a. Approve  Agreement  with  Toro Enterprises,  Inc., for the lease of 13050  Paramount  Blvd
  (Assessor  ID No. of 6264-004-900)  in the City  for the purpose  of staging  construction
  equipment  and  materials  for  the  duration  of  the  City  of  Downey  Alley  Pavement
  Rehabilitation  Project;  and

  b. Authorize  the Mayor  to execute  the Agreement  in a form  acceptable  to the City Attorney.

FISCAL  IMPACT:  By leasing  City  property  to Toro  Enterprises  Inc. at a rate of $3,000  dollars
per month  for the duration  of the City  of Downey  Alley  Pavement  Rehabilitation  Project,  the City
will  receive  a payment  of $9,000  for the 3 months  of occupation.  The monies  will  be deposited  in
the City's  Housing  Authority  Predevelopment  Costs  for 13050  Paramount  Blvd.  Account  240-
650-43-9120.  Leasing  this underutilized  City  property  will  provide  revenue  for the maintenance
of this Housing  Authority  property,  as well  as a suitable  staging  area, for the Contractor  to oversee
the construction  activities  of the City  of Downey  Alley  Pavement  Rehabilitation  Project.

BACKGROUND:  The City owns al.32-acre  parcel  of land bordered  north  by Gardendale  Street,
by residences  belonging  to the City  of Paramount  to the east, by Paramount  Blvd.  to the west, and
McKinley  Ave.  to the south.  Currently,  the parcel  is underutilized  and for the most part is vacant
with  the exception  of an 18,000  square  foot  vacant  building  formerly  used as a grocery  store on
the southern  end of the property.  The remaining  property  has sufficient  area to provide  a staging
yard for the contractor  required  to manage  the project.

  I

  5
 Below  are some highlights  of the lease:

  *  The effective  period of the lease is from November  25, 2025 to March 25, 2025. The lease
  rate is $3,000 dollars per month.
  *  The site may be used for the purpose of staging construction  equipment  and materials  for
  the duration of the project.
  *  Personnel  may access the site from 5:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., Monday  through  Friday.
  *  Tractor trailers may access the site solely for the purposes of material  deliveries,  and/or
  material storage, from 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Monday through Friday.
  *  At the end of the lease, the contractor  will  remove  all nibbish,  trash and debris within  the
  limits of the lease area.

The City of Downey  Alley  Pavement  Rehabilitation  Project is currently  underway.

  GROUND  LEASE  AGREEMENT

This Ground Lease Agreement (this "Lease") is entered into as of November 25, 2025, by and
between SOUTH  GATE  HOUSING  AUTHORITY,  a California  municipal  corporation
("Landlord"),  and TORO ENTERPRISES,  INC., a California corporation ("Tenant"),  each of
whom is sometimes referred to herein individually  as a "Party" and collectively as the "Parties".
This Lease is made with reference to the following:

  RECIT  ALS

  A.  Landlordistheownerofrealpropertylocatedatl3050ParamountB1vd,intheCity
of South Gate, County of Los Angeles, California 90280; having an Assessor's Parcel Number of
6264-004-900 ("Property").

  B.  Tenant would like to use a portion of the Property as a construction staging  area in
connection with an alley improvement project on Paramount Blvd. for the City of Downey.

  C.  Landlord is willing to lease a portion of the Property to Tenant for such purposes,
subject to the terms and conditions of this Lease.

  AGREEMENT

  NOW, THEREFORE,  the Parties agree as follows:

1.  Lease of Premises.  Subject to the terms and conditions of this Lease, Landlord hereby
leases to Tenant, and Tenant hereby leases from Landlord, that portion of the Property containing
approximately 25,000 square feet of parking lot at the location designated as the "Premises" as
shown on the site plan attached hereto as Exhibit "A" (the "Premises").

2.  Use of Premises. This Lease grants Tenant the exclusive use of the Premises, all subject
to the terms and conditions of this Lease.

3.  Term of Lease. The term of this Lease ("Term")  shall be three months, cornmencing  on
the latest to occur of the following (the "Commencement  Date"); (a) the date on which this Lease
has been signed by Landlord and Tenant, and (b) the date on which this Lease has been ratified or
approved by Landlord's City Council. If the Tenant has not signed this Lease within ten (10) days
following the approval of the City of South Gate's City Council, then Landlord shall have the right
to declare this Lease null and void; As soon as the Commencement Date has been determined,
Landlord and Tenant shall execute a letter agreement or similar document specifying the exact
Commencement  Date.  The Term of this Lease shall terminate three months after the
Commencement Date.

 4.  Rent  and Deposit.

  4.1  Base Rent.  In addition  to other amounts  owing  by Tenant  to Landlord  hereunder,
Tenant  shall pay to Landlord  montMy  base rent for the use of the Premises  ("Base  Rent").  Base
Rent  shall  be due from  and after  the Commencement  Date.  During  the term  of the Lease,  the
monthly  amount  of Base  Rent  owing  by Tenant  shall  be the sum of Three  Thousand  Dollars
($3,000)  per month.  Base Rent  shall  be paid  in equal monthly  installments  of Three  Thousand
Dollars  ($3,000),  in advance  on or before  the first  (1st)  day of each calendar  month,  in lawful
money  of the United  States, to Landlord  at the notice  address  specified  in Section  30.3 below  or,
at Landlord's  option,  at such other place  as Landlord  may from  time to time designate  in writing.
Base Rent  shall  be paid  without  prior  notice  or demand,  and without  any setoff  or deduction
whatsoever.  If the Commencement  Date  falls  on a day of the month  other than the first  day of
such month  or if any payment  of Rent is for a period  which  is shorter  than one month,  the Rent for
any fractional  month  shall accrue on a daily  basis for the period  from  the date such payment  is due
to the end of such calendar  month  or to the end of the Lease Term  at a rate per day which  is equal
to 1/360  of the applicable  annual  Rent.  All  other payments  or adjustments  required  to be made
under  the terms  of this Lease that require  proration  on a time  basis shall be prorated  on the same
basis.

  4.2  . Upon  Tenant's  execution  of this Lease,  Tenant  shall deliver  to Landlord
a cash deposit  in an amount  equal  to one (1) month's  Base Rent  ("Security  Deposit")  to help
secure the perfornnance  of Tenant's  obligations  hereunder.  Landlord  shall not be required  to hold
the Security  Deposit  separate  from  Landlord's  other  funds.  The Security  Deposit  shall  not bear
interest.  The Security  Deposit  shall  secure  Tenant's  obligations  pursuant  to this Lease  and may
be drawn  on, together  with  any accrued  interest  by the Landlord,  in whole  or in part,  to cover
delinquent  rent not paid  by Tenant,  within  any applicable  notice  and cure period  and any other
events  of default  of Tenant  under  this lease.  In the event that some or all of the Security  Deposit
is drawn  against  by Landlord  and applied  against  any delinquent  rent  or other  charges  to cure
events  of default  not paid  by Tenant  within  any applicable  notice  or cure period,  Tenant  shall
within  ten (10) days after written  demand  by Landlord,  restore the Security  Deposit  to the required
amount.  At the end or termination  of t's  lease, provided  that no event  of default  then  exist,
Landlord  shall return  the Security  Deposit  to the Tenant.

5.  Tenant's  Use and Operation  of the Premises.  Subject  to the terms and provisions  of this
Lease, Tenant  shall have the exclusive  use of the Premises  for the purposes  set forth  below.

  5.1  0peration  of Premises.  Tenant  shall  use the Premises  for  the purpose  of the
parking  of construction  vehicles  and equipment,  storage  of materials  and deliveries  and for no
other  purpose.  Storage  of materials  are limited  to equipment  (backhoes,  skip  loaders,  paving
machine,  rollers)  stockpiles  (base,  cold  mix,  dirt),  manhole/utility  frames  and covers,  portable
restroom,  best  management  practices  (BMP's)  like  straw  wattles  and  sandbags,  concrete
washout/dumpster  as needed.  Tenant  must  ensure  that all materials  shall be handled  in a manner
that prevents  any discharge  or drainage  onto permeable  surfaces  onsite.  The storage  of hazardous
materials  on site is strictly  prohibited.  Tenant  shall not construct  any improvements  on, under,  or
over  the Premises.  Tenant  shall be responsible,  at its expense,  for procuring  and maintaining  any
permits,  licenses  and/or  approvals  necessary  for the Tenant's  operation  of the Premises.

personnel  between  5:00 am and 7:00 pm during  the regular  work  week  (Monday  through  Friday)
unless  otherwise  authorized  by  the  Community  Development  Director  in  writing.  All  other
activities  such as material  deliveries  and/or  material  storage,  more closely  related  to construction

Tenant  shall comply  with  the City of South  Gate noise ordinance  and shall be held responsible  for

  5.3  Site  Access.  Tenant  shall  use the entrance  located  on the northerly  side of the
intersection  of Paramount  Blvd  and Gardendale  St. located  in the City  of South  Gate. Security  of
the access gate will  be the responsibility  of the tenant  and at no time will  it be left unsecured  when
no authorized  personnel  are present  at the site. The Tenant  and all authorized  personnel  shall use
existing  access road for ingress  and egress to the designated  Tenant  compound.

  5.4  Construction  of Water  Meter  and Improvements.  Tenant  shall not construct  (or
permit  to construct)  any improvements  on, under  or over the Premises  without  Landlord's  prior
written  consent,  which  consent  may be withheld  by Landlord  in its sole discretion.  At its own
expense  and cost, Tenant  shall be authorized  to create an opening  to the current  fence around  the
Property  and shall place a fence/gates  within  the Premises.  Tenant  shall not pave the Premises  but
shall use best management  practices  to protect  the Premises.  Tenant  shall  be responsible,  at its
expense,  for obtaining  any permits,  approvals  and entitlements  necessary  to install  a water  meter
on the Premises.  Landlord  makes no representation  regarding  the need for or availability  of any of
the foregoing  permits,  approvals  or entitlements.  Tenant  and all its contractors  and subcontractors
shall perform  their  activities  in accordance  with  all applicable  statutes,  ordinances  and regulations,

  5.5  Post  Construction  Condition  of the Premises.  Tenant  shall remove  all rubbish,
trash and debris  within  the limits  of the compound  and that are within  a ten foot  wide  perimeter
around  the  Tenants  fenced  compound.  All  debris  to include,  but  not  limited  to construction
materials,  base materials  and all other materials  not native  to the area will  be removed  offsite  and
disposed  of properly  in compliance  with  all applicable  codes  and ordinances.  The site shall  be
returned  neat and cleared.

  5.6  Compliance  with  Law.  Tenant  shall not use or occupy  the Premises  or any other
portion  of the Property  in any manner  which  violates  any applicable  present  or future  laws  and
regulations  of any local,  state or federal  agency  or entity  having  jurisdiction  over the condition,
use  or occupancy  of the Premises  and/or  the Property.

Premises  shall remain  the property  of the Landlord.

expense,  keep the Premises,  in good and sanitary  condition  and repair  at all times  during  the Term.
All  damage,  injury  or breakage  to any part or portion  thereof,  caused by the willful  misconduct  or

destruction  of the Premises  during  the Term.

13.  Waiver  of Claims.  During  the Lease Term,  Tenant  shall hold Landlord  free and harmless

by reason  of  any  injury  to  any  person  (including  Tenant's  directors,  employees,  invitees  or

SUBJECT:  APPRO  AL  OF SOUTH  GATE  HOUSING  AUTHORITY  MEETING  MINUTES.

PURPOSE:  To historically  preserve  the events of the South  Gate Housing  Authority  Meetings.

RECOMMENDED  ACTION:  The  South  Gate  Housing  Authority  will  consider  approving  the
Regular  Meeting  Minutes  of September  23, 2025.

FISCAL  IMPACT:  None.

ANALYSIS:  The minutes  are provided  to the South  Gate Housing  Authority  on the Wednesday  prior

to their  regular  business  meeting.  Atnendments  should  be provided  to the City  Clerk's  Office  within

24 hours  of a South  Gate Housing  Authority  Meeting  so that verification  of the record  and corrections

are made  accordingly.  A revised  document  will  be provided  to the South  Gate Housing  Authority

prior  to the Meeting.

BACKGROUND:  The minutes  typically  describe  the events  of the meeting  and may include  a list of

attendees,  a statement  of the issues  considered  by the participants,  and related  responses  or decisions

for the issues.
